teaser.en: Named after safari ants, though no one can quite say why.
teaser.sw: Umepewa jina la siafu, ingawa hakuna anayeweza kusema hasa kwa nini.
teaser.dg: Unaihwa kpwa dzina ra tsalafu, ela takuna mutu anayemanya hasa sababu.

summary.en: Mtsalafu is coffee senna, a common weed of farms and roadsides with yellow flowers and long thin pods. Its Digo name means 'safari ants', a link Pakia found no explanation for.
summary.sw: Mtsalafu ni *coffee senna*, gugu la kawaida la mashambani na kando ya barabara lenye maua ya manjano na maganda marefu membamba. Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana ya 'siafu', uhusiano ambao Pakia hakupata maelezo yake.
summary.dg: Mtsalafu ni *coffee senna*, mbondo ya kawaida ya minda na kanda-kanda ya njira, yenye maruwa ga rangi ya mandano na makakaya marefu membamba. Mana ya dzinare ra Chidigo ni 'tsalafu', na Pakia kaphaha maelezo ga uhusiano uho.

about.en: Mtsalafu is an upright, rank-smelling herb or soft shrub, usually waist-high, with leaves divided into four to six pairs of pointed leaflets. It bears bright yellow flowers followed by long, thin, flattened pods packed with seeds. The Digo recognise it by its leaves.
about.sw: Mtsalafu ni mmea uliosimama wima, wenye harufu mbaya, au kichaka laini, kwa kawaida kimo cha kiuno, wenye majani yaliyogawanyika katika jozi nne hadi sita za vijani vilivyochongoka. Huzaa maua ya manjano angavu yanayofuatwa na maganda marefu, membamba na yaliyobapa, yaliyojaa mbegu. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: Mtsalafu ni mmea mdide unaoima chocho, au chitsaka laini, wenye arufu mbii, na kpwa kawaida ni wa ure wa chunu. Chila kodza rinaganyika kuhenda jozi nne hadi sita za makodza madide genye ntsa. Unalavya maruwa ga rangi ya mandano inayong'ala, na badaye kunatuluka makakaya marefu, membamba na ga bapa, genye tembe nyinji. Adigo nkuumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: Originally from tropical America, it is now a widespread weed of cultivated land, compounds, roadsides and waste ground.
where.sw: Asili yake ni Amerika ya kitropiki, lakini sasa ni gugu lililoenea katika ardhi inayolimwa, viwanja vya nyumba, kando ya barabara na ardhi isiyotumika.
where.dg: Asiliye ni tsi za dzoho za Amerika, ela sambi ni mbondo inayophahikana phatu phanji kpwenye minda, mihalani, kanda-kanda ya njira na kpwenye tsi isiyohumirwa.

uses.en: Pakia records no Digo use. Elsewhere the roasted seeds have been used as a coffee substitute, hence its English name, but the raw seeds and plant are toxic to livestock.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote ya Kidigo. Kwingineko mbegu zilizokaangwa zimetumika badala ya kahawa, ndiyo sababu ya jina lake la Kiingereza, lakini mbegu mbichi na mmea wenyewe ni sumu kwa mifugo.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika matumizi ga Adigo. Phatu phanjina tembe zichiochwa zahumirwa badala ya kahawa, na ndiyo sababu kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *coffee senna*; ela tembe zisizoochwa na mmea wosi ni sumu kpwa mifugo.

culture.en: Pakia gives it as an example of a plant named after an animal for reasons no one could explain.
culture.sw: Pakia anautoa kama mfano wa mmea uliopewa jina la mnyama kwa sababu ambazo hakuna aliyeweza kuzieleza.
culture.dg: Pakia anaulavya dza mfwano wa mmea uriohewa dzina ra nyama kpwa sababu ambazo takuna mutu ariyeweza kuzieleza.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsalafu and explains it as 'safari ants', though the connection between the plant and the ants is not clear. Mgombato confirms tsalafu as the safari ant. In English it is coffee senna or negro coffee; its scientific name is Senna occidentalis (formerly Cassia occidentalis).
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsalafu na kulifafanua kuwa 'siafu', ingawa uhusiano kati ya mmea na siafu haueleweki. Mgombato inathibitisha kwamba tsalafu ni siafu. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *coffee senna* au *negro coffee*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Senna occidentalis (zamani Cassia occidentalis).
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mtsalafu na anarieleza kukala ni 'tsalafu', ela uhusiano kahi ya mmea uhu na tsalafu tauonekana waziwazi. Kamusi ya Mgombato nayo inaandika kukala tsalafu ni *safari ant*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *coffee senna* au *negro coffee*; dzinare ra chisayansi ni Senna occidentalis (kare uriihwa Cassia occidentalis).

reason.en: Also named after an animal for unclear reasons
reason.sw: Nao pia umepewa jina la mnyama kwa sababu zisizo wazi
reason.dg: Nao unaihwa kpwa dzina ra nyama kpwa sababu zisizomanyikana

reason.sw: Gugu jingine la kawaida la mashambani
reason.dg: Mbondo yanjina ya kawaida ya minda
